summary: Implement golden QGIS workflow and proof-first onboarding
details: Added a deterministic EPSG:4326 coordinate audit with expected artifacts, negative tests, output readback, QGIS Processing adapter and honest native NOT RUN boundary. Moved install, copyable request, golden workflow and evidence status into the English/Arabic front door and homepage while preserving the protected author panel.
